implementation_notes: Version 1.1 (December 2019) revises the June 2018 initial edition's Data Section to reflect the 2018 amendment to the Unfair Competition Prevention Act introducing protection for 'shared data with limited access' (effective July 1, 2019), while retaining the June 2018 AI Section. The guidelines are explicitly non-binding reference materials and model contracts intended to reduce transaction costs and foster B2B contracting practices without restricting freedom of contract. The Data Section addresses three contract types (data provision, data creation, and data sharing/platform), and the AI Section proposes an 'exploratory staged' development approach (assessment, PoC, development, and retraining) centered on quasi-mandate contracts and tailored usage conditions rather than strict IP ownership disputes. Although the guidelines impose no legal obligations or sanctions of their own, they highlight compliance considerations under existing Japanese laws (Personal Information Protection Act, Antimonopoly Act, Subcontract Act, Unfair Competition Prevention Act, Copyright Act, Foreign Exchange and Foreign Trade Act) and international regimes such as the EU GDPR.
